mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) inhibits catecholamine metabolism while propranolol blocks beta-adrenergic receptors, creating a paradoxical risk of severe hypertension if sympathomimetics are used, plus additive CNS depression and potential for hypertensive crisis.
action: Avoid this combination if possible; if necessary, use with extreme caution, monitor blood pressure closely, and avoid all sympathomimetic agents including those in OTC products.
